title: RAVA Living System — Combined final composition
prompt: A cohesive Persian RTL RAVA TEAM flagship homepage combining one product-pure light Hero, an optical 3D glass Navbar and Mega Menu, a live website canvas transforming from wireframe to finished site, responsive tablet/mobile previews and a Draft-to-Preview-to-Published rail. The lower viewport transitions into one midnight cinematic platform walkthrough showing Content, Design, Preview and Release as a flowing sequence. Use pearl, deep navy, smoke glass, controlled cobalt and verified green. Exclude buildings, abstract decoration, fake proof, generic cards and oversized flat buttons.
approvalNote: Owner approved D as the first implementation foundation; implementation must improve detail quality while preserving the approved composition and product clarity.
supersededReason: D2 preserves the approved topology while replacing the rejected interior subject with truthful RAVA product and creative-workspace imagery.
